messages.subject: renderPlot(), renderleaflet() display html text when when nrow = 0
parts:
Using  renderPlot()  (w/ ggplot2 plot )  &  renderLeaflet() in a shiny app.

Question: How to handle the case where an empty (nrow = 0) data frame is reactively supplied to ggplot2 (in renderPlot())  & to leaflet (in renderLeaflet()) ?

Currently, when nrow = 0,  renderPlot() and renderLeaflet() display blank windows.

How can I get a renderPlot() & renderLeaflet to display  html text in this situation? 

Thank you!
